I’m happy to pull up the details for you—could you let me know:

- The name of the doctor you’re booked with (e.g., Dr. Singh, Dr. Patel, etc.), or  
- Your appointment ID (the 6‑ or 7‑digit code that was sent when you booked).

Once I have that, I’ll retrieve the exact date, time, and any other relevant information for you right away. Thank you!
